newsitem.title: USA: S&P to add United Water, Halter to index.
newsitem.headline: S&P to add United Water, Halter to index.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp on Wednesday said United Water Resources Inc and Halter Marine Group Inc would replace Compression Labs Inc and Omega Environmental Inc in the S&P SmallCap 600 Index.
The moves will take place after the close of trading on Monday, March 31, S&P's said.

Harrington Park, New Jersey-based United Water Resources is the nation's second-largest investor-owned water utility, serving customers in 13 states. The company will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Water Utilities industry group in the Utilities economic sector.
Halter Marine Group is a shipbuilder specializing in the construction, repair and conversion of ocean-going and inland waterway vessels.
Trinity Industries, a component of the S&P MidCap 400 Index, is to spin off its remaining 81 percent stake in Halter Marine to its shareholders on March 31.
Halter Marine, headquartered in Gulfport, Mississippi, will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Manufacturing industry group in the Capital Goods economic sector.
Compression Labs, which makes videoconferencing systems, had a market capitalization of about $34.7 million after the close of trading on March 25, ranking last in the S&P SmallCap 600, S&P said.
S&P said Omega Environmental had a market capitalization of about $41.1 million.
